title: Woman at Statue of Liberty, 1949 B&W Snapshot NYC
location: Liberty Island, New York City, New York, USA
description: Black and white vintage snapshot dated June 11, 1949, capturing a woman in a light dress looking up toward the massive granite pedestal of the Statue of Liberty on Liberty Island (then Bedloe's Island) in New York Harbor. Additional tourists are visible seated near the wall of Fort Wood and walking into the landmark entry.
